evidence_items.claim: Dawd Haque, Global lead for COO Regulatory Market Initiatives at Deutsche Bank, is actively involved in DRR/CDM industry groups including the Global Derivatives Digital Regulatory Reporting Group, chairs IDSC at Bank of England, and participates in DTCC Global Trade Repository Steering Committee
evidence_items.excerpt: Dawd represents Deutsche Bank on the DTCC Global Trade Repository Steering Committee and is a member of the Global Derivatives Digital Regulatory Reporting Group
evidence_items.caveats: Membership indicates awareness and participation but not production commitment. Individual participation may not reflect bank-wide strategy.

evidence_items.claim: Dawd Haque discussed DRR and CDM in JWG RegCast podcast, indicating Deutsche Bank is part of industry effort to digitize derivatives trade reporting using CDM
evidence_items.excerpt: Dawd Haque from Deutsche Bank discussed the industry's collaborative effort to get derivatives trade reporting right, working with over a dozen sell and buy-side firms to digitize reporting processes
evidence_items.caveats: Conference/podcast participation indicates awareness but dated (2022). No confirmation of current implementation status.

evidence_items.claim: Deutsche Bank uses DTCC Data Repository (Ireland) Plc for EU EMIR reporting and DTCC Derivatives Repository Ltd for UK EMIR reporting - traditional trade repository approach
evidence_items.excerpt: Deutsche Bank offers a reporting service to the DTCC Data Repository (Ireland) Plc to help NFC+ and FC clients comply with their EMIR reporting obligations. For UK EMIR, Deutsche Bank offers a reporting service to the DTCC Derivatives Repository Ltd.
evidence_items.caveats: This is the current regulatory reporting infrastructure. DTCC connectivity is standard but does not preclude parallel CDM development.

evidence_items.claim: Deutsche Bank AG has representation on ISDA's Board of Directors through their Global Head of Sustainable Finance (London office)
evidence_items.excerpt: Deutsche Bank AG, London has representation on ISDA's Board of Directors through their Global Head of Sustainable Finance.
evidence_items.caveats: ISDA Board membership indicates industry engagement but does not specifically imply CDM adoption. Sustainable Finance focus may not relate to derivatives technology.
